select_all_exploitability.reason: Conditional F2 penalizes false positives whenever a useful candidate is selected; false-positive-only selections remain at zero reward.

interpretation.conclusion: The conditional-F2 C-v2 repair passed reward-safety gates and produced a finite changed adapter, but did not improve frozen terminal success or retrieval support recall. Adaptive Retriever remains only a later optional engineering ablation and was not started.
